messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway-usw2. Spike started ~21:12 UTC. Routing to alex (oncall). Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/alerts/3579123456

alex (oncall): Acknowledged. Looking into logs and recent deploys.

sam (eng-sre): Seeing segfault loop in model-runner on node pool 'gpu-rt-1a'. Repeats of SIGSEGV + OOM messages. Pasting last 3 lines:
```
[2026-03-15T21:13:05Z] model-runner[pid=3245]: RuntimeError: allocator failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T21:13:06Z] model-runner[pid=3245]: signal SIGSEGV at 0x7f9b8c2c
[2026-03-15T21:13:06Z] model-runner[pid=3245]: backtrace: quant_attention_bitset.c:423 free()+0x12
```

maria (eng-runtime): Confirmed. Canary shows quant_attention kernel hitting a use-after-free after allocator exhaustion. Sequence length distribution skewed up (more long seqs) and K/V cache growth saturating memory. Recent quant kernel tweak merged ~48h ago.

lee (eng-platform): Starting immediate mitigations: 1) Route 30% of production inference traffic to fallback model variant rwd-small-v1 2) Scale up gpu-rt-1a pool by +2 nodes 3) Enable fast-fail for sequences >2048. Applying now.

alex (oncall): Routing change applied (route-id: r-cc9f). Monitoring metrics.

jon (support): Noted customer-facing errors: 4 customers with high error rates on generation endpoints (acme-corp, betaapps, gamma-studios, delta-ops). Drafting interim status update to send in 10m.

tara (incident-commander): Owners: eng-runtime (maria) = root cause & fix, eng-sre (sam) = capacity/eviction, eng-platform (lee) = routing + rollout, support (jon) = customer comms. 10m cadence updates. If mitigated, prepare handoff.

maria (eng-runtime): Pushed hotfix branch that reverts the quant allocator change and adds a defensive check around KV cache growth. Deploying to canary now:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/quant-rollback
git revert --no-commit abcdef1234
kubectl apply -f deploy/model-runner-canary.yaml -n inference-canary
```

sam (eng-sre): Draining two suspicious instances from gpu-rt-1a. Eviction + scale completed. Early signal: 5xx rate down ~40% on canary cluster.

lee (eng-platform): Increased fallback routing to 60% while canary stabilizes. Kept fast-fail rule enabled. Config snippet:
```json
{"route":"r-cc9f","fallback":"rwd-small-v1","weight":60}
```

alex (oncall): System-wide 5xx: was 14% at peak, now 3.2% after routing+scale. Latency improved. Keeping watch.

jon (support): Sent interim status to affected customers + standard mitigation note. No customer data loss. Link to note: https://redwood.internal/status/3579123456-msg

maria (eng-runtime): Canary logs post-rollback show segfaults stopped. Running extended load test against canary for 15m before broader rollout. If clean, will promote rollback to main.

sam (eng-sre): Observed decreased OOM churn after cache TTL reduction. Memory pressure looks stable. Preparing to bring older nodes back in a controlled fashion.

tara (incident-commander): Agreed plan: 1) Promote rollback to critical clusters once canary holds for 15m 2) Keep routing/fallback until 5xx <1% for 30m 3) Postmortem owner: maria, draft due in 48h.

maria (eng-runtime): Promotion started to regional clusters (us-west-2 + eu-west-1). Rolling update command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner -n inference`

lee (eng-platform): Routing weight lowered to 20% as rollout completes. Scaling decisions remain in place for 30m.

alex (oncall): System 5xx at 0.9% over last 10m window. Customer errors trending down.

jon (support): Follow-up message sent to affected customers with mitigation summary and ETA for postmortem.

maria (eng-runtime): Root cause: regression in quant allocator path (commit abcdef1234) causing aggressive free after memmap in quant_attention. Reverted and added guard. Will include repro + unit test in PR.

sam (eng-sre): Confirming no new SIGSEGVs on rolling pools. Removing drain marks on two nodes; monitoring for relapse.

tara (incident-commander): Good work. Prepare handoff to night oncall. Summary for next oncall (lee): cause = quant kernel regression -> rollback applied; mitigations = routing fallback, scale, cache TTL; customer impact limited to transient 5xx; postmortem assigned.

alex (oncall): Handoff: mitigations applied, 5xx baseline restored, no ongoing segfaults, support notified. Moving to standby.

lee (eng-platform): Acknowledged handoff. I will monitor 4 hours and escalate to SRE lead if errors resurface.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated — 5xx returned to baseline. Postmortem ETA 48h (owner: maria). Closing pager for thread 3579123456.
